title: Countdown
statement:
Count down from a whole number to 1, then launch.

The input is one integer `n` with `n >= 0`. Print the numbers from `n` down to 1, one per line, then print `Liftoff!` on its own line. When `n` is 0 there is nothing to count, so print only `Liftoff!`.

Input:

```text
3
```

Expected output:

```text
3
2
1
Liftoff!
```
hints: Keep a counter that starts at `n` and loop while it is still above 0.
Inside the loop, add the counter to your list, then subtract 1 from it so the loop ends.
